segments.caption: At night, under bright floodlights, a cyclist rides a BMX bike around the perimeter of an empty, paved velodrome or skatepark, with other riders visible in the distance. The camera, likely mounted on a helmet or handlebar, follows the action from a first-person perspective as the rider navigates the curved track.
At night, under bright stadium lights, cyclists race around the curved, banked track of a velodrome, their bikes leaning into the turns as they compete in a fast-paced track cycling event.
At night under bright floodlights, several cyclists race around a velodrome, leaning into the curves as they navigate the banked track.

At night under bright floodlights, a group of cyclists races around a velodrome, leaning into the curves as they pedal competitively. The camera, mounted on a rider’s helmet, provides a first-person view, capturing the fast-paced action and the surrounding track environment.

At night on a brightly lit velodrome, players on bicycles compete in a fast-paced game of bike polo, using long sticks to maneuver and strike a small ball while racing around the track. The action is dynamic and close, with players in helmets and athletic gear intensely focused on the play, showcasing the speed and skill of the sport.

At night under bright floodlights, a BMX rider on a purple bike prepares for action on an indoor velodrome, while another rider in a purple shirt and helmet races ahead, using a pole to push off the track’s wall, showcasing the dynamic, high-energy atmosphere of competitive BMX cycling.
At night under bright floodlights, cyclists race around a velodrome track, leaning into turns and maneuvering their bikes with speed and focus.
At night under bright floodlights, cyclists race around a velodrome track, leaning into turns as they pedal competitively, with one rider in the foreground and others visible along the curved path.

At night under bright stadium lights, a cyclist wearing a helmet races around a paved velodrome track, skillfully maneuvering with a long pole in hand, while another player in a purple shirt crouches near a goal, ready for action.
At night under bright floodlights, players on bicycles compete in a fast-paced game of roll hockey on an outdoor rink, maneuvering with sticks to control the ball while racing around the perimeter.
At night under bright floodlights, several cyclists in helmets ride their bikes around a concrete velodrome or skatepark, navigating the curved track and occasionally passing close to the camera.

At night on an illuminated, fenced concrete rink, a group of cyclists in helmets and protective gear are actively engaged in a competitive roller hockey game, maneuvering their bikes and using sticks to control the puck.

At night under bright floodlights, a person rides a bicycle on a concrete rink, holding a long-handled stick, while other riders are visible nearby, suggesting a recreational or competitive cycling event on the rink.

At night under artificial lights, cyclists race around a concrete velodrome-style track, leaning into turns as the camera follows their fast-paced motion, with tiered bleachers and trees visible in the background.
At night under bright floodlights, a cyclist races around the banked concrete track of an outdoor velodrome, with other riders visible nearby, all moving at speed on their bikes.

At night, a person rides a scooter or skateboard rapidly along the curved concrete edge of an outdoor rink, passing a red hockey goal and a fence with the German slogan “Ein starkes Team.” The motion is fast and fluid, with the camera’s perspective shifting dynamically as they navigate the perimeter, illuminated only by a single overhead light.
